items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: He had Lil' Willie and I playing drums... I used him to throw those sticks up

ctx.x: Yes. Well, that's another story. That's another story. But he came from there, and he was... So they had a very good... He had a big band, Claude did. Came to Hollywood, and he played all over Hollywood for dances. But the brand usually broke up. He had Lil' Willie and I playing drums, one of the greatest drummers in the whole West that they ever knew. Willie would throw those sticks up and caught them. He was one of the greatest for trick drumming. He eventually was put in Lucky Day, and he was a star of Lucky…
And he just was called Lil' Willie?
